title: No trace.zip for a failed test because the config records traces only on first retry
symptoms: test-results has no trace.zip for a local failure
The HTML report shows no Traces section for the failed test
cause: The generated config uses trace: 'on-first-retry' together with retries: 0 outside CI. With no retry, nothing is recorded.
fix: Use retain-on-failure, which records every test and keeps only the failing ones.
affected: Playwright Test configs created by npm init playwright, all current versions
